:::{#exm-variance-function}
#### Variance functions of three families

Rewriting each $b''(\theta)$ from @exm-edf-mean-variance
as a function of the mean $\mu = b'(\theta)$
gives each family's variance function:

| Family    | $b''(\theta)$                              | $V(\mu)$       | $\mu$ | $V(\mu)$ |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------|----------------|-------|----------|
| Gaussian  | $1$                                        | $1$            | 2     | 1        |
| Poisson   | $e^\theta$                                 | $\mu$          | 3     | 3        |
| Poisson   | $e^\theta$                                 | $\mu$          | 10    | 10       |
| Bernoulli | $\expit(\theta)\paren{1 - \expit(\theta)}$ | $\mu(1 - \mu)$ | 0.25  | 0.1875   |
| Bernoulli | $\expit(\theta)\paren{1 - \expit(\theta)}$ | $\mu(1 - \mu)$ | 0.5   | 0.25     |

The Gaussian variance function is constant,
so the variance does not depend on the mean.
The Poisson variance function grows with the mean.
The Bernoulli variance function is largest at $\mu = 0.5$
and shrinks toward 0 as $\mu$ approaches 0 or 1.
:::
